extensionDescription.message: Securely sends the PDF print representation created by Chrome to the Fin3000 document inbox.

statusAccepted.message: Document securely received by Fin3000. Processing is in progress.

statusChecking.message: Receipt is being checked. Please do not send again.

statusNotSent.message: The document was not sent. Please print again.

statusBusy.message: Fin3000 is already processing a document. Please print again shortly.

statusConnectFirst.message: Connect Fin3000 once, then print again.

statusInvalidPdf.message: Chrome did not provide a valid PDF print representation.

statusTooLarge.message: The document is larger than 20 MiB and was not sent.

printRepresentationHelp.message: Chrome transfers the print representation. Use file upload or Fin3000 email for embedded e-invoice data or signatures.

privacyNote.message: No portal URLs, cookies or PDF data are stored permanently in the extension.
